prompt: The fact checker did not pass these claims. Fix each one: change the sentence so its quotes say everything it says, or pick quotes that do. Leave a claim out to

content.text:
Let me fix each claim based on the fact checker's feedback.

Claim 1: The quote has a typo "dois" vs "dva" - need to find the actual text. Let me look at C017.rd_capacity: "Imamo dva programera i jednog GIS specijalista koji mogu da odvoje do trećine radnog vremena za razvoj novih funkcija, uz povremenu podršku terenske ekipe za testiranje u polju."

So the correct quote is "dva programera i jednog GIS specijalista koji mogu da odvoje do trećine radnog vremena"
For claim 2 I'll go with the suggested sentence without the PostGIS reference, and claim 3 can just use the suggested wording directly. For claim 4, I need proper sourcing - the TloCare multi-year field data point comes from C017-CH3, and for the researcher's expertise I should pull from R0013's bio, which mentions quantitative modelling of soil buffering capacity and lime requirement estimation across hydromorphic and chernozem soil associations of Vojvodina.

{"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Two developers and one GIS specialist can each devote up to one-third of their working time to development work.","sources":[{"id":"C017","field":"rd_capacity","quote":"dva programera i jednog GIS specijalista koji mogu da odvoje do trećine radnog vremena"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Multi-year per-parcel measurement data are available for model validation.","sources":[{"id":"C017-CH3","field":"detail","quote":"višegodišnja merenja, što bi moglo da posluži za validaciju modela"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Buffer pH methods have been compared and calibrated with regression equations developed for chernozem texture classes to predict lime requirements in northern Vojvodina municipalities.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00143","field":"abstract","quote":"Regression equations specific to chernozem texture classes are presented"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00143","field":"abstract","quote":"five municipalities in northern Vojvodina"}]},{"claim":4,"text":"The researcher's work on quantitative modelling of soil buffering capacity and lime requirement estimation aligns with TloCare's need for improved lime recommendations, and TloCare holds multi-year field data that could validate models.","sources":[{"id":"R0013","field":"bio","quote":"quantitative modelling of soil buffering capacity and lime requirement estimation across hydromorphic and chernozem soil associations of Vojvodina"},{"id":"C017-CH3","field":"detail","quote":"višegodišnja merenja, što bi moglo da posluži za validaciju modela"}]}]}
